blockingFindings.title: Approval timestamp persistence is not asserted
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could mark approval done and sync tasks while dropping or failing to persist approval timestamps, and these tests would still pass despite violating R1.
blockingFindings.issue: R1 requires the approval status and timestamps to be persisted in the same atomic combined state, but the tests only assert the approval step status. No test checks that the completed approval step has the expected completion timestamp fields after the committed state or happy path.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion that the approval step in the committed combined state includes the expected timestamp persistence, at minimum proving the completion timestamp is present and survives the atomic mutation.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could mark approval done and sync tasks while dropping or failing to persist approval timestamps, and these tests would still pass despite violating R1.
